title: DateLogicQA: Benchmarking Temporal Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on DateLogicQA, a curated question-answering benchmark featuring various date formats, temporal contexts (past, present, future), and reasoning types (commonsense, factual, conceptual, numerical). Human annotators classify errors to distinguish between representation-level bias (caused by tokenization inconsistencies) and logical-level bias (caused by reasoning failures).
